notes: Null observation means unreached. Null proof forbids that stop. Features rounded in prompt; evaluator uses full saved precision.
No-stop time includes actual policy feature overhead and common guard. Stop times are real forced-rule serving costs but only a proxy for a new compiled rule.
All450 groups are exposed development. Five folds are grouped diagnostics, not independent validation.
Anonymous group/fold, future observations, proof hits and cost labels are evaluator information, never runtime features.
Do not identify or special-case individual queries. No text, vectors, source IDs or held-out cases are provided.
objective: zero observed per-query recall loss against guarded parent; >=.95 recall per filter; lower COMPLETE serving time including feature/no-stop and exact fallback cost
parent: guarded non-iterative native640 on same original graph; exact top10 replacement on short outputs on all arms
